text:
Jules (acct): PanEuro Trust RFP arrived. They want an EU-only POC + procurement packet: EU control plane, BYOK (HSM), no US subprocessors for this engagement, telemetry and audit logs must remain in EU. Need handoff doc by tomorrow COB.
Kay (se): Quick Q  do they accept EU-only control plane in eu-west-1 or do they specifically want eu-central-1? Also ask whether 36mo audit retention is mandatory or negotiable.
Jules (acct): They prefer eu-central-1 control plane (Frankfurt). Procurement pushed 36mo retention as a hard ask.
Arman (infra): Tech note: we can spin an EU-only control plane in eu-central-1 for the POC. BYOK HSM import requires Dedicated or Private. Hosted can use our EU KMS (eu-west-1) but keys remain in our tenancy  not acceptable for BYOK/HSM ask.
Lena (sre): Subprocessors: compute + block storage in EU (AWS eu-central-1, GCP europe-west1, Azure northeurope). Monitoring defaults to a US SaaS vendor; we can disable that and route metrics to EU-only stack for the POC. Will open ops ticket to lock telemetry and disable external plugins.
TicketBot: Created ticket #10021 "paneuro-eu-poc-geo-lock" assigned to Arman. ETA: 48h for ops checklist and telemetry isolation.
Victor (legal): 36mo audit retention is longer than standard hosted (12mo). We can propose an addendum with EU-only archival storage and costs. Need subprocessors export + proof-of-delete process and confirmation that audit exports include request/response metadata.
Kay (se): I'll draft the handoff one-pager: routing config, KMS options, VPC peering checklist, subprocessors snapshot, telemetry toggle steps, and a ballpark POC quote. Will include a sample routing payload and a curl snippet for SE testing.
Jules (acct): Ballpark pricing for RFP row? Procurement wants a single-line number for evaluation.
Kay (se): Rough estimate: Hosted EU-only POC (2-week) with telemetry isolation ~USD 17k. Dedicated with BYOK/HSM import and 1mo reserved pool ~USD 29k/mo. Add archival for 36mo logs ~USD 1.8k/mo extra (depends on volume).
Arman (infra): Sample routing payload for the doc (paste into RFP):
```json
{
  "tenant":"paneuro-trust-poc",
  "routing":{
    "mode":"pin",
    "primary_region":"eu-central-1",
    "failover_regions":["eu-west-1"],
    "egress_policy":"restrict_to_allowed_regions"
  },
  "kms":{
    "mode":"BYOK",
    "hsm_import_required":true,
    "key_location":"customer-kms-eu-central-1"
  }
}
```
Kay (se): SE test curl for quick verification:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"paneuro-trust-poc","routing":{"primary":"eu-central-1","failover":["eu-west-1"]},"kms":{"type":"BYOK","region":"eu-central-1","hsm":true}}'
```
Lena (sre): FYI if they want VPC peering we need their CIDR block(s) and a technical contact for peering setup. Also confirm they want DB replicas limited to EU only (that will affect egress allowances).
Jules (acct): I'll collect SIG and CIDRs from the buyer and DM Victor.
Victor (legal): Once we have SIG, I'll draft DPA addendum language for 36mo retention and EU-only control plane. Will also request subprocessors export from infra for inclusion.
Kay (se): Uploading 1-pager + price sketch to Drive: https://drive.redwood/POC/PanEuro-Trust. I'll attach subprocessors snapshot and ops checklist.
Jules (acct): Great work team  target to attach to RFP by tomorrow COB. :pray:
Arman (infra): +1. Will update ticket with implementation notes and expected timelines.
Lena (sre): Also scheduling a perf test window with their infra once tenant is provisioned.
Jules (acct): Perfect. I'll follow up after I get SIG and CIDRs. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
